scope: 178 original supplementary units for Darjah 1 and Darjah 2; six questions grounded in the reading of each unit.
rights: Original Study text. External pages are references and discovery links; no third-party books, images or paid worksheets reproduced.
limits: These are supplemental micro-lessons, not certification of complete KSSR syllabus coverage.
D1 letter/word cards require adult/audio support when children cannot read. Physical pictures are used for concrete tasks.
Moral and adab scenarios are original age-oriented examples; a teacher should review subject progression.
Exact textual evidence checks do not replace factual or pedagogical review.
